ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.

3. When learning Combinational Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Combinational Logic Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Combinational Logic Circuits.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

7. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.

8. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

9. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

10. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.

11. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

12. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

13. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

14. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

15. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

16. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.
